summary: Frontend-only validation of (A) plan switching propagation in Plan Gráfico, (B) UUID-free Sport/Model names in GraphicPlan header & sidebar & PLAN ACTIVO tile, and (C) NEW competition date modal (main + secondary). Tested with super admin (3 plans: 2 x Boxeo+ATR 47sem, 1 x Judo custom-model 4sem). RESULTS: (A) PLAN SWITCH PROPAGATES — PASS. Switching from Boxeo 47sem (input-duration '47 sem · 11 meses', model 'ATR (Issurin)') to Judo 4sem ('4 sem · 1 mes'), cell-etapa count correctly drops to 4. Switching back returns to 47 sem / 11 meses. (B-sport) Sport name renders as 'Boxeo' / 'Judo' (NOT UUID) in GraphicPlan header — PASS. (B-model GraphicPlan) Model name for Boxeo plans = 'ATR (Issurin)' (PASS), but for the Judo plan the input-model field STILL renders the raw UUID '40422f46-4ce2-4fc8-b1f9-c1ad5c79911f' — FAIL (regression NOT fixed from iter_92). (B-sidebar) Same UUID leaks in [data-testid='sidebar-plan-8b945365-...'] subtitle: '40422f46-4ce2-...' — FAIL. (B-PLAN ACTIVO header) NEW UUID leak observed in the active-plan header strip after entering Plan Gráfico: a UUID 'bc8b15ff-622a-4a67-9eb8-8d1fc8e687cb' is rendered as a tag next to 'ATR (Issurin)' / '47 semanas' (likely coach_id or athlete_id) — NEW FAIL. (C-MAIN MODAL) comp-cell-main_competition-<week> click opens comp-date-modal — PASS. Fill comp-modal-name+comp-modal-date and click comp-modal-save closes modal and shows toast 'Competencia principal actualizada' — PASS. The 'Conflicto de fechas' warning recalculates (showed 'semana 27/47' for date today+60d) — PASS. HOWEVER the 🏆 marker is NOT rendered inside the 'Competencia principal' SUB-ROW cells (comp-cell-main_competition-*) — marker_cells=[]. Trophies only show in parent 'Eventos / Competencias' aggregate row — FAIL (sub-row visual marker missing/not reubicated). (C-SECONDARY MODAL) comp-cell-secondary_competition-<week> opens modal — PASS. Save closes modal and toast 'Competencia secundaria agregada (sincronizada con módulo Competencias)' appears — PASS. But the secondary sub-row cells remain visually empty (sec_marker_cells=[]) — FAIL (no marker placed in the secondary_competition sub-row at the saved week).

ui_bugs.issue: Model field still shows raw UUID '40422f46-4ce2-4fc8-b1f9-c1ad5c79911f' instead of a friendly name. resolveModelName/getModelName falls back to the id when the model is not in /api/periodization-library. Same plan tested in iter_92 — not fixed.
Sidebar plan card subtitle still leaks UUID '40422f46-4ce2-...' for the Judo plan (8b945365-145f-...). Carry-over from iter_92.

ui_bugs.component: Plan Gráfico — active plan header strip (PLAN ACTIVO tile/top of Plan Gráfico)
ui_bugs.issue: After navigating into Plan Gráfico, the top header renders a stray UUID tag 'bc8b15ff-622a-4a67-9eb8-8d1fc8e687cb' next to '47 semanas / ATR (Issurin)'. Appears to be coach_id or athlete_id rendered raw. NEW UUID leak — not in scope of iter_92's review but visible in screenshot for plan 25b9abc7 (Boxeo + ATR).

After saving main_competition via comp-date-modal (toast OK, conflict alert recalculates), the 🏆 marker is NOT painted in the comp-cell-main_competition-<week> sub-row. eventsByWeek mapping into the sub-row appears to ignore activePlan.main_competition_date / patched onPlanUpdated. Trophies only render in the parent 'Eventos / Competencias' aggregate row (and at weeks 21/22, not the new week 27). So users do NOT see the marker reubicate in the principal sub-row.

After saving secondary_competition (toast 'Competencia secundaria agregada (sincronizada con módulo Competencias)' OK), no visible marker / emoji / dot is rendered in the comp-cell-secondary_competition-<week> sub-row. localCompetitions update probably not feeding back into the sub-row cell renderer.

integration_issues.flow: Save main_competition date → relocate trophy marker
integration_issues.issue: PATCH /api/training-plans/{id}/competition is presumably succeeding (toast says so) and onPlanUpdated() is called, but the GraphicPlan render does not refresh the comp-cell-main_competition-<week> sub-row marker based on the new main_competition_date. Either eventsByWeek dependency array is missing activePlan.main_competition_date or the marker is rendered from a different memoized list that does not include the patch.

POST /api/plan-data/competitions returns OK (toast confirms) but localCompetitions/eventsByWeek isn't recomputed into comp-cell-secondary_competition cells. Recommend pushing the newly-created competition into localCompetitions state immediately and including it in the week→event map used by the sub-row.

When a plan was created against a custom periodization-model id not present in /api/periodization-library (e.g. 40422f46-...), GraphicPlan & PlanSidebar both fall back to the raw id. Should fallback to plan.model_name / plan.periodization_type_name / 'Modelo personalizado'.

issues: A raw UUID 'bc8b15ff-622a-4a67-9eb8-8d1fc8e687cb' is rendered as a tag next to model/duration — should be replaced with a friendly label or hidden from the UI.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): In GraphicPlan AND PlanSidebar resolve plan.model with fallback chain: libraryById[plan.model]?.name || plan.model_name || plan.periodization_type_name || 'Modelo personalizado'. The Judo plan (8b945365-145f-...) keeps leaking '40422f46-...' in BOTH input-model and the sidebar card. Regression from iter_92.
FIX (HIGH): Remove the raw UUID tag 'bc8b15ff-622a-...' from the Plan Gráfico top header (likely coach_id/athlete_id field rendered without a name lookup). Replace with athlete/coach name or hide.

FIX (HIGH): After PATCH /training-plans/{id}/competition and onPlanUpdated patch, the GraphicPlan must paint the 🏆 marker in comp-cell-main_competition-<week_of_main_competition_date>. Either include activePlan.main_competition_date in the eventsByWeek useMemo deps OR derive a separate 'mainCompWeek' memo and inject the emoji into the sub-row td renderer. Confirm cellRenderer for act.id==='main_competition' actually checks the date.

FIX (HIGH): After POST /plan-data/competitions for secondary, push the new competition into localCompetitions immediately (optimistic update) and ensure the cell renderer for act.id==='secondary_competition' maps competitions by week (compute week from competition.date and plan.start_date).
(Carry-over LOW) Add VisuallyHidden DialogTitle to remove the two 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle' console warnings emitted on dashboard load.
critical_code_review_comments: GraphicPlan.js line ~636: `if (activePlan.macrocycles?.length > 0 && lastImportedPlanRef.current !== activePlan.id) { … importPeriodizationData(activePlan.macrocycles[0]); }` — works (plan switch propagates), GOOD.

GraphicPlan.js line ~634: `model: modelName || prev.model` — modelName comes from modelMap[activePlan.model], but for a custom model not in the library this returns undefined and the field falls through to activePlan.model (the raw UUID). Add `|| activePlan.model_name || 'Modelo personalizado'`.

GraphicPlan.js openCompModal/saveCompModal logic LGTM for PATCH/POST, but the visual feedback in the comp-cell sub-rows is missing — the cell renderer at line ~2362 should overlay an emoji based on (a) activePlan.main_competition_date for main_competition row, (b) localCompetitions list for secondary_competition row. Verify both code paths.

DashboardPage.js: Header strip in Plan Gráfico shows a UUID-looking tag — likely rendering plan.coach_id / plan.athlete_id rather than coach_name / athlete_name. Same pattern as the iter_92 fix on sport/model — apply name lookup here too.

success_rate.frontend: 55% — PASS: plan switch propagates, sport name resolved, modal opens+saves for both main & secondary, toast OK, conflict alert recalculates. FAIL: model UUID leak (Judo) in GraphicPlan & sidebar, new coach_id UUID leak in header strip, 🏆 marker NOT painted/reubicated in main_competition sub-row, no marker painted in secondary_competition sub-row.

seed_data_creation: Created via UI for test purposes: a 'TEST Main Champ' main competition (date today+60d) on plan 25b9abc7-... and a 'TEST Secondary Event' secondary competition (date today+30d) on the same plan. Main agent may want to clean these up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login as super admin → click [data-testid='tab-planes'] → click [data-testid='sidebar-plan-<id>'] to select plan. Then [data-testid='tab-datos'] → [data-testid='section-tab-visualizacion'] → [data-testid='subnav-graphic-plan']. Read inputs: input-sport / input-model / input-duration. Plans: Boxeo+ATR id=25b9abc7..., Judo+custom-model id=8b945365... (this is the one that LEAKS the model UUID 40422f46-...), Boxeo+ATR Copia id=b55f151e.... To repro the trophy marker bug: on plan 25b9abc7 click [data-testid='comp-cell-main_competition-13'] → fill comp-modal-name/comp-modal-date → comp-modal-save; toast appears but main row sub-row marker does NOT render. Same for [data-testid^='comp-cell-secondary_competition-']. Also the active-plan header strip at the top of Plan Gráfico shows 'bc8b15ff-622a-4a67-9eb8-8d1fc8e687cb' raw UUID — that is a new UUID leak to fix.
rca_of_the_issue: (1) Model UUID leak (Judo): same RCA as iter_92 — plan.model is a custom UUID not present in /api/periodization-library, so the lookup map returns undefined and the code falls back to activePlan.model. Fix: add fallback `|| activePlan.model_name || 'Modelo personalizado'` in both GraphicPlan.js (model field in setGeneralInfo) and PlanSidebar.js. (2) Header strip UUID 'bc8b15ff-...': likely the Plan Gráfico header is rendering plan.coach_id or plan.athlete_id directly. Need a name lookup similar to sportMap/modelMap (coachMap, athleteMap) — currently shown raw. (3) Trophy marker not reubicating in main_competition sub-row: openCompModal/saveCompModal correctly call PATCH + onPlanUpdated, but the sub-row cell at line ~2362 (cellRenderer for comp-cell-main_competition-<week>) doesn't react to activePlan.main_competition_date changes — either eventsByWeek useMemo missing activePlan.main_competition_date in dep array or the per-sub-row renderer doesn't use eventsByWeek at all. (4) Secondary marker missing: after POST /plan-data/competitions, localCompetitions is not optimistically updated; even if it is, the secondary_competition sub-row renderer likely doesn't compute week-from-date for each entry. Recommend: derive eventsByWeek using {date → week} = `Math.floor( (new Date(comp.date) - new Date(plan.start_date)) / (1000*60*60*24*7) ) + 1` and inject 🏆/star emoji into the matching td.
